name: Five Nights at Lust
source:
In Five Nights at Lust, you will follow the story of a young man who has lost his memories and is desperately in need of money.
With no past to rely on and no idea of what the future holds, he takes the only opportunity that comes his way: a job at a somewhat shady nightclub.
What first seems like a simple way to make some quick money soon turns into something far more complicated. As the nights go by, strange encounters and mysterious characters make him question just what he has gotten himself into.
Perhaps getting this job wasn't just a stroke of luck...
Maybe it was fate.
translation:
在《情欲五夜》中，你将跟随一名失去记忆、急需用钱的年轻男子展开故事。
既没有过往可依凭，也不知未来在何方，他只能抓住眼前唯一的机会：去一家来路可疑的夜总会打工。
这份起初看似只是赚快钱的简单差事，很快就演变得扑朔迷离。随着一个个夜晚过去，离奇的邂逅与神秘的人物不禁让他怀疑自己究竟卷入了怎样的旋涡。
或许得到这份工作并非一时走运……
而是命中注定。
